t: Forge Steel 2-piece wire brush set designed for efficient rust removal, paint stripping, and for preparing various surfaces for painting or finishing. The set includes a brass-plated brush for delicate surfaces and a natural wire brush for tougher cleaning tasks. Each brush features a durable plastic handle for a comfortable grip, and 130mm head length, ideal for professional tradespeople and serious DIYers tackling renovation projects or restoration work in workshops and on-site. Effectively removes scale and other unwanted fragments without causing damage, to ensure smooth, clean finish.
